raw: {"analysis":"BTN provides a more coherent and realistic delivery plan that properly sequences the work (analysis before test implementation) and handles the repository constraints well. It correctly identifies the dual approval gate for staging-fin, addresses the flaky currency conversion check with retry logic, and optimizes CI costs through batching. VNK has some structural issues: it claims Lane B runs in parallel with Lane A but also says it starts after the schema is known, creating ambiguity about sequencing. VNK also introduces a Compliance Lead review of invariants that goes beyond what the ticket requests (the ticket asks to codify observed historical behavior, not regulatory compliance), and its Gate 1 requiring Compliance Lead sign-off before any coding adds an unnecessary bottleneck not implied by the repository facts. Both plans handle the mock-ledger reset cycle and rollback strategy adequately, but BTN's plan is more tightly aligned with the actual request and constraints.","verdict": "BTN"}
